newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips recoup losses to end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips recoup losses to end little changed.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks clawed their way back from steep losses to end little changed Thursday.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 5.78 points to close at 6,442.49 after falling 95 points earlier in the session. The drop came after a report on strong manufacturing activity in December sparked fears of higher interest rates. In the broader market, declines led advances by about a 9-4 margin on active volume of 465 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
